q: 他们踢了一个___小时足球。
zh: 他们踢了一个半小时足球。
py: tā men tī le yí gè bàn xiǎo shí zú qiú
en: They played football for an hour and a half.
why: With a whole number, 半 goes right after the measure and before the noun: 一个半小时. 半个 would repeat the measure.

q: 我女儿今年三岁___了，已经会游泳了。
zh: 我女儿今年三岁半了，已经会游泳了。
py: wǒ nǚ ér jīn nián sān suì bàn le yǐ jīng huì yóu yǒng le
en: My daughter is three and a half now and can already swim.
why: 岁 is its own measure, so 半 comes last: 三岁半. 半个 cannot attach to 岁.

s: 他是一千九百九十八年出生的。
s_py: tā shì yī qiān jiǔ bǎi jiǔ shí bā nián chū shēng de
zh: 他是一九九八年出生的。
py: tā shì yī jiǔ jiǔ bā nián chū shēng de
en: He was born in 1998.
why: Years are read digit by digit: 一九九八年. Reading it as a quantity is wrong.

zh: 这是我第二次参加比赛。
py: zhè shì wǒ dì èr cì cān jiā bǐ sài
en: This is my second time in a competition.
why: 第二次 is 第 + 二 + 次. 第 must come before the number, and second is 二, not 两.

q: 这次比赛，___八十的运动员都参加了第一场。
zh: 这次比赛，百分之八十的运动员都参加了第一场。
py: zhè cì bǐ sài bǎi fēn zhī bā shí de yùn dòng yuán dōu cān jiā le dì yī cháng
en: Eighty percent of the athletes in this competition took part in the first event.
why: Percent is 百分之 + number. 八十百分 copies the English order, and 百分 loses the 之.

q: 我今天跑了___，累得不想动了。
zh: 我今天跑了三公里多，累得不想动了。
py: wǒ jīn tiān pǎo le sān gōng lǐ duō lèi dé bù xiǎng dòng le
en: I ran a bit over three kilometres today and I'm too tired to move.
why: With a number from one to nine, the extra bit goes after the measure: 三公里多. 三多公里 puts 多 in the round-number slot.

s: 球场上有三十个多人在跑步。
s_py: qiú chǎng shàng yǒu sān shí gè duō rén zài pǎo bù
zh: 球场上有三十多个人在跑步。
py: qiú chǎng shàng yǒu sān shí duō gè rén zài pǎo bù
en: There are thirty-odd people running on the field.
why: After a round number, 多 comes before the measure: 三十多个人. 三十个多人 splits 多 from the number.

q: 球场上有二十___学生在踢球。
zh: 球场上有二十多个学生在踢球。
py: qiú chǎng shàng yǒu èr shí duō gè xué shēng zài tī qiú
en: There are twenty-odd students playing football on the field.
why: After a round number like 二十, 多 sits on the number, before the measure: 二十多个. 个多 is for one to nine, and 左右 cannot go before 个.

q: 现在___，球赛该开始了。
zh: 现在两点半，球赛该开始了。
py: xiàn zài liǎng diǎn bàn qiú sài gāi kāi shǐ le
en: It's half past two now, the match should start.
why: Counting the hour two on a clock is 两点, and 半 comes after 点. 二点 is a classic slip, and 半 can never go in front of the hour.

q: 球拍三十九块五，我给了老板五十块，他应该找我___。
zh: 球拍三十九块五，我给了老板五十块，他应该找我十块五。
py: qiú pāi sān shí jiǔ kuài wǔ wǒ gěi le lǎo bǎn wǔ shí kuài tā yīng gāi zhǎo wǒ shí kuài wǔ
en: The racket is 39.50 yuan, and I gave the boss fifty, so he should give me back 10.50.
why: Ten yuan and fifty fen is 十块五, with 毛 dropped. 十块零五 would be 10.05, which is not the right change.

s: 我弟弟今年二十个岁，已经是队长了。
s_py: wǒ dì di jīn nián èr shí gè suì yǐ jīng shì duì zhǎng le
zh: 我弟弟今年二十岁，已经是队长了。
py: wǒ dì di jīn nián èr shí suì yǐ jīng shì duì zhǎng le
en: My younger brother is twenty this year and is already the captain.
why: 岁 is itself the measure, so no 个 comes between the number and 岁.

q: 这双球鞋一百___块钱，我觉得有点贵。
zh: 这双球鞋一百多块钱，我觉得有点贵。
py: zhè shuāng qiú xié yì bǎi duō kuài qián wǒ jué de yǒu diǎn guì
en: These shoes are a hundred-odd yuan, and I think that's a bit expensive.
why: After 一百, 多 follows the number directly: 一百多块. 个多 is not used with 块, and 几 cannot follow 百 directly.

s: 现在五分差七点，我们快去球场吧。
s_py: xiàn zài wǔ fēn chà qī diǎn wǒ men kuài qù qiú chǎng ba
zh: 现在差五分七点，我们快去球场吧。
py: xiàn zài chà wǔ fēn qī diǎn wǒ men kuài qù qiú chǎng ba
en: It's five to seven now, let's hurry to the field.
why: 差 has to come first: 差五分七点. The minutes cannot stand in front of 差.

zh: 这双球鞋要一千零八十块。
py: zhè shuāng qiú xié yào yī qiān líng bā shí kuài
en: These sports shoes cost one thousand and eighty yuan.
why: 一千零八十: the empty hundreds place gets one 零, between 一千 and 八十.

q: 我等了___，他还没来。
zh: 我等了半个小时，他还没来。
py: wǒ děng le bàn gè xiǎo shí tā hái méi lái
en: I've waited half an hour and he still hasn't come.
why: Half alone goes before the measure: 半个小时. 小时半 puts 半 last, which is only for units that are their own measure.

q: 这辆自行车一千___八十块，不便宜。
zh: 这辆自行车一千零八十块，不便宜。
py: zhè liàng zì xíng chē yī qiān líng bā shí kuài bù biàn yí
en: This bike costs one thousand and eighty yuan, which isn't cheap.
why: The hundreds place is empty in 1080, so a single 零 follows 千: 一千零八十. 一千百八十 and 一千十八十 are not numbers.

zh: 星期六下午三点球场见。
py: xīng qī liù xià wǔ sān diǎn qiú chǎng jiàn
en: See you at the field at three on Saturday afternoon.
why: Weekday, then part of the day, then hour: big to small, with the time before the rest of the sentence.

s: 这个乒乓球钱三块。
s_py: zhè ge pīng pāng qiú qián sān kuài
zh: 这个乒乓球三块钱。
py: zhè ge pīng pāng qiú sān kuài qián
en: This table tennis ball is three yuan.
why: The price follows the subject, and 钱 can only come after the unit (三块钱). 钱 before the number is not Chinese.

q: 这是他___次参加马拉松，他说这次一定要跑完。
zh: 这是他第三次参加马拉松，他说这次一定要跑完。
py: zhè shì tā dì sān cì cān jiā mǎ lā sōng tā shuō zhè cì yí dìng yào pǎo wán
en: This is his third time running a marathon, and he says he will definitely finish this time.
why: 'The third time' needs 第 before the number: 第三次. 三次 only counts three times, and 第三个次 mixes two measure words.

q: 这场比赛有___个人来看，体育场坐满了。
zh: 这场比赛有十万个人来看，体育场坐满了。
py: zhè chǎng bǐ sài yǒu shí wàn gè rén lái kàn tǐ yù chǎng zuò mǎn le
en: A hundred thousand people came to watch the match and the stadium was full.
why: Chinese counts in 万, so 100,000 is 十万. 千 never takes a number above nine in front of it, so 一百千 is impossible.

s: 我们三点下午明天去爬山。
s_py: wǒ men sān diǎn xià wǔ míng tiān qù pá shān
zh: 我们明天下午三点去爬山。
py: wǒ men míng tiān xià wǔ sān diǎn qù pá shān
en: We're going hiking at three tomorrow afternoon.
why: Time runs big to small: day, part of the day, hour. 三点下午明天 is English order reversed.

zh: 我的孩子两岁半了。
py: wǒ de hái zi liǎng suì bàn le
en: My child is two and a half now.
why: 岁 is its own measure and a counted two is 两: 两岁半, with 半 at the end.

q: 现在是十___点，商店里的人越来越多。
zh: 现在是十二点，商店里的人越来越多。
py: xiàn zài shì shí èr diǎn shāng diàn lǐ de rén yuè lái yuè duō
en: It's twelve o'clock now, and the shop is getting more and more crowded.
why: Inside 十二点 the digit stays 二. 两 is only for a bare 'two' hour, so 十两点 does not exist.

q: 现在五点___，再过十五分钟商店就关门了。
zh: 现在五点三刻，再过十五分钟商店就关门了。
py: xiàn zài wǔ diǎn sān kè zài guò shí wǔ fēn zhōng shāng diàn jiù guān mén le
en: It's a quarter to six now, and the shop closes in fifteen minutes.
why: 三刻 is forty-five minutes past the hour, so 五点三刻 is a quarter to six. 一刻 would be 5:15 and 半 would be 5:30, which would not close in fifteen minutes.

q: 这瓶运动饮料___块，很便宜。
zh: 这瓶运动饮料两块，很便宜。
py: zhè píng yùn dòng yǐn liào liǎng kuài hěn pián yi
en: This bottle of sports drink is two yuan, very cheap.
why: A counted two before 块 is 两: 两块. 二块 is the learner error; 二 is kept for 二十, 十二 and the final digit in 三块二.

s: 这个体育场能坐十千人。
s_py: zhè ge tǐ yù chǎng néng zuò shí qiān rén
zh: 这个体育场能坐一万人。
py: zhè ge tǐ yù chǎng néng zuò yī wàn rén
en: This stadium holds ten thousand people.
why: Ten thousand has its own unit, 万. 千 is never preceded by a number above nine, so 十千 does not exist.

q: 这次旅行一共三个___月，我们去了很多地方。
zh: 这次旅行一共三个半月，我们去了很多地方。
py: zhè cì lǚ xíng yī gòng sān gè bàn yuè wǒ men qù le hěn duō dì fāng
en: The trip lasted three and a half months in all, and we visited many places.
why: 月 needs 个, so 半 sits between the measure and the noun: 三个半月. 多半 means 'most likely'.

zh: 这个月我花了工资的三分之一。
py: zhè ge yuè wǒ huā le gōng zī de sān fēn zhī yī
en: This month I spent a third of my salary.
why: 三分之一: denominator first, then 分之, then the numerator. 一分之三 would be three over one.

zh: 小王住在五楼。
py: xiǎo wáng zhù zài wǔ lóu
en: Xiao Wang lives on the fifth floor.
why: Floors use a bare number: 五楼, with no 第.

q: 我打了三___月网球，打得越来越好了。
zh: 我打了三个多月网球，打得越来越好了。
py: wǒ dǎ le sān gè duō yuè wǎng qiú dǎ dé yuè lái yuè hǎo le
en: I've played tennis for a bit over three months and am getting better.
why: With a number from one to nine, 多 follows the measure: 三个多月. 三多个月 and 三多月 put 多 where a round number would take it.

q: 我们___去打羽毛球。
opts: 一月十号明年四点下午
下午四点十号一月明年
明年一月十号下午四点
zh: 我们明年一月十号下午四点去打羽毛球。
py: wǒ men míng nián yí yuè shí hào xià wǔ sì diǎn qù dǎ yǔ máo qiú
en: We're going to play badminton at four on the afternoon of January 10th next year.
why: Year, month, day, part of the day, hour: always largest first, all before 去. The other options scramble that order or put the small units first.

zh: 我的房间是四幺五。
py: wǒ de fáng jiān shì sì yāo wǔ
en: My room is 415.
why: Room numbers are read digit by digit, and the digit one is said 幺: 四幺五.

zh: 我们等了一个半小时。
py: wǒ men děng le yí gè bàn xiǎo shí
en: We waited for an hour and a half.
why: With a whole number, 半 goes after the measure 个 and before 小时: 一个半小时.

q: 我学打网球已经___了，下个月就要参加比赛。
zh: 我学打网球已经两个月了，下个月就要参加比赛。
py: wǒ xué dǎ wǎng qiú yǐ jīng liǎng gè yuè le xià gè yuè jiù yào cān jiā bǐ sài
en: I've been learning tennis for two months and will enter a competition next month.
why: Here a length of time is counted, so it is 两个月. 二月 and 第二月 name February or the second month, not a duration.

q: 这是我___次来这个球场。
zh: 这是我第二次来这个球场。
py: zhè shì wǒ dì èr cì lái zhè ge qiú chǎng
en: This is my second time at this field.
why: An ordinal is 第 + number, and second is 第二, never 第两. 两次 would just count two times, not say it is the second.

q: 球赛从七___开始，打了两个小时。
zh: 球赛从七点开始，打了两个小时。
py: qiú sài cóng qī diǎn kāi shǐ dǎ le liǎng gè xiǎo shí
en: The match started at seven o'clock and lasted two hours.
why: A clock time takes 点, a length of time takes 小时. 七个小时 would be seven hours, which clashes with the two hours played.

zh: 我们七点左右到。
py: wǒ men qī diǎn zuǒ yòu dào
en: We'll arrive at about seven.
why: 左右 comes after the number phrase: 七点左右. It cannot stand before 七点.

zh: 我们在海边玩了两天半。
py: wǒ men zài hǎi biān wán le liǎng tiān bàn
en: We spent two and a half days at the seaside.
why: 天 is its own measure, so 半 comes last: 两天半.

zh: 这个排球三块五。
py: zhè ge pái qiú sān kuài wǔ
en: This volleyball is three yuan fifty.
why: 块 first, then the dropped-unit 五: 三块五, 3.50 yuan.

q: 我弟弟上___年级，已经会游泳了。
zh: 我弟弟上二年级，已经会游泳了。
py: wǒ dì di shàng èr nián jí yǐ jīng huì yóu yǒng le
en: My younger brother is in second grade and can already swim.
why: School grades are position names, so they take the bare number: 二年级. 两年级 and 第二年级 are not used.

s: 我们踢了一个小时半足球。
s_py: wǒ men tī le yí gè xiǎo shí bàn zú qiú
zh: 我们踢了一个半小时足球。
py: wǒ men tī le yí gè bàn xiǎo shí zú qiú
en: We played football for an hour and a half.
why: 半 attaches right after the measure 个 and before 小时: 一个半小时. 一个小时半 puts it at the end.

q: 比赛七点一___开始，快走吧。
zh: 比赛七点一刻开始，快走吧。
py: bǐ sài qī diǎn yī kè kāi shǐ kuài zǒu ba
en: The match starts at a quarter past seven, let's hurry.
why: A quarter past is 点 + 一刻. 七点一分 would be one minute past seven, and 半 would be seven thirty, so neither fits 'quarter past'.

s: 今天星期六，我们去打球吧。
s_py: jīn tiān xīng qī liù wǒ men qù dǎ qiú ba
zh: 今天星期六，我们去打球吧。
py: jīn tiān xīng qī liù wǒ men qù dǎ qiú ba
en: It's Saturday today, let's go and play ball.
why: A positive weekday sentence needs no 是: 今天星期六 is the normal way to say it, so nothing is missing here.

q: 我只买了___个乒乓球，用不了多久。
zh: 我只买了几个乒乓球，用不了多久。
py: wǒ zhǐ mǎi le jǐ gè pīng pāng qiú yòng bù liǎo duō jiǔ
en: I only bought a few table tennis balls, they won't last long.
why: 几 stands in for a small unknown number and sits in the number slot before 个. 左右 and 大概 both need a real number to go with.

q: 这双球鞋三百___五块。
zh: 这双球鞋三百零五块。
py: zhè shuāng qiú xié sān bǎi líng wǔ kuài
en: These sports shoes cost three hundred and five yuan.
why: The tens place is empty, so one 零 fills the gap: 三百零五. Without it, 三百五 means 350 in speech, and 三百十五 is not said.

q: 他们是二零一零年六月十二号___在北京结婚的。
zh: 他们是二零一零年六月十二号晚上八点在北京结婚的。
py: tā men shì èr líng yī líng nián liù yuè shí èr hào wǎn shàng bā diǎn zài běi jīng jié hūn de
en: They got married in Beijing at eight in the evening on June 12th, 2010.
why: The part of the day comes before the hour (晚上八点), after the date. 八点晚上 copies the English habit of putting the hour first.

q: 他每天八点___起床，所以上班总是迟到。
zh: 他每天八点半起床，所以上班总是迟到。
py: tā měi tiān bā diǎn bàn qǐ chuáng suǒ yǐ shàng bān zǒng shì chí dào
en: He gets up at half past eight every day, so he is always late for work.
why: Half past is 点 + 半, with nothing else added. 三十半 doubles up, and thirty minutes is never called 两刻.

q: 我儿子是二零一八年___出生的。
zh: 我儿子是二零一八年三月十二号出生的。
py: wǒ ér zi shì èr líng yī bā nián sān yuè shí èr hào chū shēng de
en: My son was born on March 12th, 2018.
why: After the year comes the month, then the day. 十二号三月 puts the day before the month, which is the reverse of Chinese order.

q: 我的房间号是六八___，在六楼。
zh: 我的房间号是六八二，在六楼。
py: wǒ de fáng jiān hào shì liù bā èr zài liù lóu
en: My room number is 682, on the sixth floor.
why: Digits in a room number are read one by one, and two stays 二. 两 belongs to counting, such as 两个人.

zh: 我们俱乐部有一百零五个会员。
py: wǒ men jù lè bù yǒu yì bǎi líng wǔ gè huì yuán
en: Our club has a hundred and five members.
why: 一百零五: one 零 fills the empty tens place. 一百五 would be 150.

q: 我们___到球场，你别迟到。
zh: 我们七点左右到球场，你别迟到。
py: wǒ men qī diǎn zuǒ yòu dào qiú chǎng nǐ bié chí dào
en: We'll get to the field at about seven, don't be late.
why: 左右 follows the whole number phrase: 七点左右. The word that goes in front of the number is 大概, never 左右.

zh: 火车九点零五分开。
py: huǒ chē jiǔ diǎn líng wǔ fēn kāi
en: The train leaves at five past nine.
why: Minutes under ten take 零 after 点: 九点零五分. The time stays before the verb 开.

zh: 操场上有三十多个人在跑步。
py: cāo chǎng shàng yǒu sān shí duō gè rén zài pǎo bù
en: There are thirty-odd people running on the sports field.
why: After a round number like 三十, 多 comes before the measure: 三十多个人.

q: 我儿子今年___岁了。
zh: 我儿子今年两岁了。
py: wǒ ér zi jīn nián liǎng suì le
en: My son is two this year.
why: Two years old is 两岁, because 岁 is a measure and a counted two is 两. 二岁 is the learner error.

q: 我们队里___二的队员是女生，剩下的是男生。
zh: 我们队里三分之二的队员是女生，剩下的是男生。
py: wǒ men duì lǐ sān fēn zhī èr de duì yuán shì nǚ shēng shèng xià de shì nán shēng
en: Two thirds of the players on our team are girls and the rest are boys.
why: The denominator comes first: 三分之二 is two thirds. 二分之二 would be all of them, and 三之分 scrambles 分之.

q: 你买了两个排球，一共___，请扫码付钱。
zh: 你买了两个排球，一共四十六块八，请扫码付钱。
py: nǐ mǎi le liǎng gè pái qiú yī gòng sì shí liù kuài bā qǐng sǎo mǎ fù qián
en: You bought two volleyballs, 46.80 yuan altogether, please scan to pay.
why: The big unit goes first: 四十六块, then 八. Putting 块 after the small number or the small number first is not Chinese price order.

s: 这双运动鞋一百十块钱，太贵了。
s_py: zhè shuāng yùn dòng xié yì bǎi shí kuài qián tài guì le
zh: 这双运动鞋一百一十块钱，太贵了。
py: zhè shuāng yùn dòng xié yì bǎi yī shí kuài qián tài guì le
en: These sports shoes are a hundred and ten yuan, which is too expensive.
why: Inside a bigger number ten is said 一十: 一百一十. 一百十 skips the 一.

s: 我第二月去北京参加比赛。
s_py: wǒ dì èr yuè qù běi jīng cān jiā bǐ sài
zh: 我二月去北京参加比赛。
py: wǒ èr yuè qù běi jīng cān jiā bǐ sài
en: I'm going to Beijing for a competition in February.
why: Month names are bare numbers, so 二月. 第二月 would mean 'the second month' as an ordinal, which is not how months are named.

q: 我们在海边玩了两天___。
zh: 我们在海边玩了两天半。
py: wǒ men zài hǎi biān wán le liǎng tiān bàn
en: We played at the seaside for two and a half days.
why: 天 is its own measure, so 半 ends the phrase: 两天半. 半个 wrongly adds a measure word that 天 never takes.

zh: 球赛十二月三十号晚上七点开始。
py: qiú sài shí èr yuè sān shí hào wǎn shàng qī diǎn kāi shǐ
en: The match starts at seven in the evening on December 30th.
why: The date comes before the part of the day and hour, and the whole time expression is in front of 开始.

q: 我是___年开始学网球的。
zh: 我是二零一五年开始学网球的。
py: wǒ shì èr líng yī wǔ nián kāi shǐ xué wǎng qiú de
en: I started learning tennis in 2015.
why: Years are read digit by digit: 二零一五. Reading them as a quantity (二千十五) is not Chinese.

s: 羽毛球两块五一个，你买几个？
s_py: yǔ máo qiú liǎng kuài wǔ yí gè nǐ mǎi jǐ gè
zh: 羽毛球两块五一个，你买几个？
py: yǔ máo qiú liǎng kuài wǔ yí gè nǐ mǎi jǐ gè
en: Shuttlecocks are two yuan fifty each, how many do you want?
why: Two is 两 before 块, and the last unit is dropped: 两块五. No 是 or 有 is needed before a price.

s: 我住三楼，球场在二楼。
s_py: wǒ zhù sān lóu qiú chǎng zài èr lóu
zh: 我住三楼，球场在二楼。
py: wǒ zhù sān lóu qiú chǎng zài èr lóu
en: I live on the third floor, and the court is on the second floor.
why: Floors take bare numbers (三楼, 二楼) with no 第, and two stays 二 in an ordered name.

q: 这个月我们花了工资的___，买了不少运动装备。
zh: 这个月我们花了工资的三分之一，买了不少运动装备。
py: zhè ge yuè wǒ men huā le gōng zī de sān fēn zhī yī mǎi le bù shǎo yùn dòng zhuāng bèi
en: This month we spent a third of our pay on sports gear.
why: A fraction names the bottom number first: 三分之一. 一分之三 reverses it, which would mean three over one.

q: 已经___了，比赛马上开始，你怎么还在逛商店？
zh: 已经差十分十点了，比赛马上开始，你怎么还在逛商店？
py: yǐ jīng chà shí fēn shí diǎn le bǐ sài mǎ shàng kāi shǐ nǐ zěn me hái zài guàng shāng diàn
en: It's already ten to ten and the match is about to start, so why are you still shopping?
why: 'Ten to ten' is 差 + minutes + hour: 差十分十点. The minutes cannot stand in front of 差, and 差十点十分 would mean lacking ten o'clock.

q: 这家体育用品公司去年赚了三___块，老板很高兴。
zh: 这家体育用品公司去年赚了三千万块，老板很高兴。
py: zhè jiā tǐ yù yòng pǐn gōng sī qù nián zhuàn le sān qiān wàn kuài lǎo bǎn hěn gāo xìng
en: This sports goods company made thirty million yuan last year, and the boss was very pleased.
why: Thirty million is three thousand 万: 三千万. 三百万 is only three million, and 三万万 is not how it is said.

q: 我们队这次得了___名，只比第一名少两分。
zh: 我们队这次得了第二名，只比第一名少两分。
py: wǒ men duì zhè cì dé le dì èr míng zhǐ bǐ dì yì míng shǎo liǎng fēn
en: Our team came second this time, only two points behind first.
why: A rank is 第 + number + 名, and second is 第二. 第两名 is the classic mistake, and 两名 would mean two people.

q: 我学游泳已经学了___，可以参加比赛了。
zh: 我学游泳已经学了一年半，可以参加比赛了。
py: wǒ xué yóu yǒng yǐ jīng xué le yī nián bàn kě yǐ cān jiā bǐ sài le
en: I've been learning to swim for a year and a half, and can enter races now.
why: 年 is its own measure, so a whole number plus half is 一年半, with 半 last. The other two reorder the pieces.

zh: 一共是四十六块八。
py: yī gòng shì sì shí liù kuài bā
en: That's forty-six yuan eighty altogether.
why: The big unit 四十六块 comes first and the final 八 follows it with 毛 dropped.

s: 这双球鞋一千零五十块，比上个月贵了三百多块。
s_py: zhè shuāng qiú xié yī qiān líng wǔ shí kuài bǐ shàng gè yuè guì le sān bǎi duō kuài
zh: 这双球鞋一千零五十块，比上个月贵了三百多块。
py: zhè shuāng qiú xié yī qiān líng wǔ shí kuài bǐ shàng gè yuè guì le sān bǎi duō kuài
en: These shoes are one thousand and fifty yuan, three hundred-odd yuan more than last month.
why: 一千零五十 has one 零 for the empty hundreds place, and 三百多块 puts 多 right after the round number. Both are correct.

q: 他今年一共跑了一百___公里，真厉害。
zh: 他今年一共跑了一百一十公里，真厉害。
py: tā jīn nián yī gòng pǎo le yì bǎi yī shí gōng lǐ zhēn lì hài
en: He ran 110 kilometres in total this year, which is impressive.
why: Inside a bigger number ten is said 一十: 一百一十. 一百十 skips the 一, and 零 is only for an empty place, not for a ten.

q: 球赛在___开始。
zh: 球赛在星期六下午三点开始。
py: qiú sài zài xīng qī liù xià wǔ sān diǎn kāi shǐ
en: The match starts at three on Saturday afternoon.
why: Time runs from big to small: weekday, part of the day, hour. The other tiles start from the hour, which is English order and not Chinese.

q: 乒乓球馆在___楼。
zh: 乒乓球馆在三楼。
py: pīng pāng qiú guǎn zài sān lóu
en: The table tennis hall is on the third floor.
why: Floors name a position with a bare number: 三楼. 第 is not added, and 三个楼 would be three separate buildings.

q: 这家俱乐部才成立了两年___，会员却已经有两千多人了。
zh: 这家俱乐部才成立了两年多，会员却已经有两千多人了。
py: zhè jiā jù lè bù cái chéng lì le liǎng nián duō huì yuán què yǐ jīng yǒu liǎng qiān duō rén le
en: This club has only been set up for a little over two years, yet it already has over two thousand members.
why: 年 is its own measure, so 多 follows it: 两年多. 两个年多 wrongly adds 个, and 左右多 is not a pattern.

q: 这个气球三块___，买两个吧。
zh: 这个气球三块五，买两个吧。
py: zhè ge qì qiú sān kuài wǔ mǎi liǎng gè ba
en: This balloon is three yuan fifty, buy two.
why: 钱 can only follow a complete unit (五块钱), not a dropped one. 三块五钱 and 三块五块钱 both repeat or break the unit pattern.

zh: 现在差五分八点。
py: xiàn zài chà wǔ fēn bā diǎn
en: It's five to eight now.
why: 差 comes before the minutes: 差五分八点. 五分差八点 is wrong, because the minutes cannot stand before 差.

q: 今天不___星期六，是星期天。
zh: 今天不是星期六，是星期天。
py: jīn tiān bú shì xīng qī liù shì xīng qī tiān
en: Today isn't Saturday, it's Sunday.
why: A positive weekday can drop 是 (今天星期六), but 不 needs 是 after it. 不星期六 is impossible, and 有 does not state what day it is.

zh: 百分之八十的球迷都来了。
py: bǎi fēn zhī bā shí de qiú mí dōu lái le
en: Eighty percent of the fans came.
why: 百分之 goes first, then the number: 百分之八十. The number cannot come before 百分之.

s: 现在差十分九点，球赛快开始了。
s_py: xiàn zài chà shí fēn jiǔ diǎn qiú sài kuài kāi shǐ le
zh: 现在差十分九点，球赛快开始了。
py: xiàn zài chà shí fēn jiǔ diǎn qiú sài kuài kāi shǐ le
en: It's ten to nine now, and the match is about to start.
why: 差 comes before the minutes and the coming hour comes last: 差十分九点 is exactly right.

s: 现在二点半，球赛开始了。
s_py: xiàn zài èr diǎn bàn qiú sài kāi shǐ le
zh: 现在两点半，球赛开始了。
py: xiàn zài liǎng diǎn bàn qiú sài kāi shǐ le
en: It's half past two now, and the match has started.
why: The hour two before 点 is 两, so 二点 is the error. 二 stays only in 十二点 and in minutes.

q: 这件运动服一百二十三块___，你要吗？
zh: 这件运动服一百二十三块五毛，你要吗？
py: zhè jiàn yùn dòng fú yì bǎi èr shí sān kuài wǔ máo nǐ yào ma
en: This tracksuit is 123 yuan 50, do you want it?
why: After 块 comes the number and then 毛, largest unit first: 五毛. The number must stand in front of 毛, so 毛五 reverses it.

s: 我打了半年乒乓球，就喜欢上了。
s_py: wǒ dǎ le bàn nián pīng pāng qiú jiù xǐ huān shàng le
zh: 我打了半年乒乓球，就喜欢上了。
py: wǒ dǎ le bàn nián pīng pāng qiú jiù xǐ huān shàng le
en: I played table tennis for half a year and grew to like it.
why: Half alone goes before the measure, and 年 takes no 个: 半年 is correct.

q: 中国有十四___人，喜欢打乒乓球的人很多。
zh: 中国有十四亿人，喜欢打乒乓球的人很多。
py: zhōng guó yǒu shí sì yì rén xǐ huān dǎ pīng pāng qiú de rén hěn duō
en: China has 1.4 billion people, and many of them like playing table tennis.
why: 1.4 billion is 十四亿, because 亿 is a hundred million. 十四万 would be only 140,000 and 十四千万 is not a possible number.

q: 来看比赛的有两万___人，座位都坐满了。
zh: 来看比赛的有两万多人，座位都坐满了。
py: lái kàn bǐ sài de yǒu liǎng wàn duō rén zuò wèi dōu zuò mǎn le
en: More than twenty thousand people came to watch the match, and all the seats were full.
why: After a round number, 多 comes straight after it: 两万多人. 左右 would have to follow 人 (两万人左右), and 个多 does not work with 万.

q: 我住在八___八房间。
zh: 我住在八二八房间。
py: wǒ zhù zài bā èr bā fáng jiān
en: I'm staying in room 828.
why: Room numbers are read digit by digit, and the digit two stays 二. 两 is for counting two of something.

q: 我想买___年的健身卡，一年的太贵了。
zh: 我想买半年的健身卡，一年的太贵了。
py: wǒ xiǎng mǎi bàn nián de jiàn shēn kǎ yī nián de tài guì le
en: I want to buy a half-year gym card, since a full year is too expensive.
why: Half alone goes before the measure, and 年 takes no 个: 半年. 半个年 is the learner error, and 一半 means half of something.

q: 这家体育俱乐部是___年成立的，已经有二十多年的历史了。
zh: 这家体育俱乐部是一九九八年成立的，已经有二十多年的历史了。
py: zhè jiā tǐ yù jù lè bù shì yī jiǔ jiǔ bā nián chéng lì de yǐ jīng yǒu èr shí duō nián de lì shǐ le
en: This sports club was founded in 1998 and has more than twenty years of history.
why: A year is read digit by digit: 一九九八. Reading it as a quantity, 一千九百九十八, is something no native does.

s: 他跑了三个多小时，累坏了。
s_py: tā pǎo le sān gè duō xiǎo shí lèi huài le
zh: 他跑了三个多小时，累坏了。
py: tā pǎo le sān gè duō xiǎo shí lèi huài le
en: He ran for a bit over three hours and was exhausted.
why: With a number from one to nine, 多 follows the measure: 三个多小时. This is the correct slot.

s: 他今年左右三十岁，是我们的教练。
s_py: tā jīn nián zuǒ yòu sān shí suì shì wǒ men de jiào liàn
zh: 他今年三十岁左右，是我们的教练。
py: tā jīn nián sān shí suì zuǒ yòu shì wǒ men de jiào liàn
en: He is about thirty this year and is our coach.
why: 左右 follows the number phrase: 三十岁左右. It can never stand before the number.

q: 你的孩子今年___岁了？
zh: 你的孩子今年几岁了？
py: nǐ de hái zi jīn nián jǐ suì le
en: How old is your child this year?
why: A child's age is asked with 几 straight before 岁. 几个岁 adds a measure word 岁 never takes, and 哪 is not a number word.

q: 这款运动手表去年一共卖了两千___八个。
zh: 这款运动手表去年一共卖了两千零八个。
py: zhè kuǎn yùn dòng shǒu biǎo qù nián yī gòng mài le liǎng qiān líng bā gè
en: This sports watch sold two thousand and eight units in total last year.
why: 2008 has two empty places in the middle, and they get a single 零: 两千零八. Writing 两千八 would mean 2,800.

q: 我们的比赛在___月举行。
zh: 我们的比赛在二月举行。
py: wǒ men de bǐ sài zài èr yuè jǔ xíng
en: Our match is held in February.
why: Month names are bare numbers, and February is 二月. 两月 and 第二月 do not exist; 两个月 would be a length of two months.

zh: 他今天跑了三公里多。
py: tā jīn tiān pǎo le sān gōng lǐ duō
en: He ran a bit over three kilometres today.
why: With a number from one to nine, 多 follows the measure: 三公里多. 三多公里 is wrong.

q: 我只买了___个乒乓球。
zh: 我只买了一个乒乓球。
py: wǒ zhǐ mǎi le yí gè pīng pāng qiú
en: I only bought one table tennis ball.
why: 幺 is only for digit strings like phone and room numbers. A counted one is always 一.

q: 我的手机只剩___二十的电了，别玩游戏了。
zh: 我的手机只剩百分之二十的电了，别玩游戏了。
py: wǒ de shǒu jī zhǐ shèng bǎi fēn zhī èr shí de diàn le bié wán yóu xì le
en: My phone only has twenty percent battery left, so stop playing games.
why: 百分之 goes in front of the number: 百分之二十. The number can never come before 百分, and 之 cannot be left out.

q: 一个乒乓球三块___，一盒十个。
zh: 一个乒乓球三块五，一盒十个。
py: yí gè pīng pāng qiú sān kuài wǔ yī hé shí gè
en: A table tennis ball is three yuan fifty, ten to a box.
why: The last unit is dropped, so 三块五 means 3.50. 三块五块 repeats the unit, and 是 is not needed between 块 and the number.

q: 银行___点关门，我们快去取钱吧。
zh: 银行两点关门，我们快去取钱吧。
py: yín háng liǎng diǎn guān mén wǒ men kuài qù qǔ qián ba
en: The bank closes at two, let's hurry and withdraw some money.
why: The hour two before 点 is always 两: 两点. 二点 is the learner error; 二 stays inside 十二点 and in minutes like 二十分.

zh: 比赛三点一刻开始。
py: bǐ sài sān diǎn yī kè kāi shǐ
en: The match starts at a quarter past three.
why: 一刻 follows 三点 directly, and the clock time sits before the verb 开始.

s: 我们队三分之二的队员是学生，剩下的是老师。
s_py: wǒ men duì sān fēn zhī èr de duì yuán shì xué shēng shèng xià de shì lǎo shī
zh: 我们队三分之二的队员是学生，剩下的是老师。
py: wǒ men duì sān fēn zhī èr de duì yuán shì xué shēng shèng xià de shì lǎo shī
en: Two thirds of the players on our team are students, and the rest are teachers.
why: 三分之二 names the denominator first and then the numerator, so two thirds is written exactly like this.

q: 报警电话是___。
zh: 报警电话是幺幺零。
py: bào jǐng diàn huà shì yāo yāo líng
en: The police emergency number is 110.
why: Phone numbers are read digit by digit, with 幺 for one. 一百一十 is the quantity one hundred and ten.
